versions.changelog:
Initial release: Complete Qlik Cloud analytics platform integration with 37 operational tools.

- Enables health checks, app management, data reloads, and search across all Qlik Cloud resources.
- Supports natural language queries (Insight Advisor), AI assistants (Qlik Answers), AutoML, automations, data alerts, governance, and lineage.
- Includes comprehensive script documentation for all key workflows: apps, reloads, users, data files, lineage, alerts, and more.
- All interactions use environmental variables and output standardized JSON.
- Cloud-only features (Automations, AutoML, etc.) are clearly indicated.
